meta.label: EN
meta.title: KOMPACS · Prior scans for comparison before CT, MRI, PET and tumor boards
meta.description: KOMPACS (KOMparátor PACS) finds the relevant prior exams before a CT, MRI, PET or tumor board, checks them in PACS and requests what is missing. Winner of Rakathon 2026.
meta.og_title: KOMPACS · No exam without a comparison.
meta.og_description: Before a CT, MRI, PET or tumor board, it finds the relevant prior exams, checks them in PACS and requests what is missing.

hero.tagline: Prior scans for comparison before CT, MRI, PET and tumor boards
hero.lead: KOMPACS finds them in the NIS, in report text and with the insurer, checks them in PACS and requests the missing ones.

problem.an_old_scan_is: An old scan is missing. The case waits, a nurse hangs on the phone.
problem.before_a_ct_or: Before a CT or tumor board, the comparison scans are not in PACS.
problem.where_they_were_done: Where they were done is only a sentence in a report.
problem.the_physician_waits_a: The physician waits, a nurse calls, the patient waits.
problem.cases_in_the_demo: cases in the demo data lack a scan the physician needs.
problem.radiologists_love_two_things: Radiologists love two things in life: darkness and complete patient data. Sadly, today's healthcare mostly gives them only the darkness.

solution.the_check_runs_by: The check runs by itself, the moment an exam is ordered.
solution.exactly_the_workflow_from: Exactly the workflow from the FN Motol and Na Homolce brief:
solution.relevant_or_not_with: Relevant or not. With a reason and a guideline citation.
solution.decides_the_uncertain_ones: Decides the uncertain ones. Approves the request in one click.

ai.for_every_scan_a: For every scan: a reason, the source sentence and a verified guideline citation. When the AI is unsure, a human decides.
ai.patients_often_forget_the: Patients often forget. The insurer never forgets what it paid for.
ai.insurer_data_note: Insurer data: KOMPACS works without it. A link to insurers adds exams that no hospital knows about. Simulated in the prototype.

compass.found_in_a_report: Found in a report, missing in PACS
compass.aria: A compass finds a missing prior exam

data.cases_lack_a_scan: cases lack a scan in PACS that the physician needs
data.all_34_missing_scans: All 34 missing scans are named only in report text. A NIS or PACS search does not find them.

innovation.the_obvious_solution_would: The obvious solution would not find the missing scans.
innovation.query_nis_and_pacs: Query NIS and PACS. Finds 0 of 34 missing priors.
innovation.ai_reads_report_text: AI reads report text: “CT at Thomayer Hospital 12/2025”. Finds all 34.
innovation.ask_the_patient_they: Ask the patient. They often do not remember where or when.
innovation.ask_the_insurer_it: Ask the insurer. It knows exams that no single hospital knows (14 in the demo).
innovation.an_ai_voice_bot: An AI voice bot calls hospitals. It reads sensitive data to whoever picks up.
innovation.a_precise_e_mail: A precise e-mail or FHIR request. Verified contact. A human approves.
innovation.a_black_box_ai: A black-box AI, or fixed rules. The physician cannot see why.
innovation.a_reason_the_source: A reason, the source sentence and a verified guideline citation. A human decides the uncertain ones.
innovation.a_new_system_the: A new system. The hospital changes its processes, integration is slow and costly.
innovation.connects_what_the_hospital: Connects what the hospital has: HL7 v2, FHIR, a PACS feed. The hospital changes nothing.

security.no_ai_robots_on: No AI robots on the phone. A precise e-mail in one click.
security.picture_our_ai_reaching: Picture our AI reaching the hospital porter and reciting a birth number and a cancer diagnosis. Funny, yes. But your data protection officer would have a heart attack.
security.subject: Subject
security.image_request_chest_and: Image request: chest and abdomen CT 12/2025
security.hello_for_a_ct: Hello, for a CT planned on 23 Oct we kindly ask for the images and report of the chest and abdomen CT from 12/2025 via ePACS. Patient: PAC-DEMO-001. Thank you.
security.ai_draft_approved_by: AI draft · approved by the coordinator
security.hl7_v2_in_fhir: HL7 v2 in, FHIR R4 inside, vector search in IRIS.
security.report_text_goes_only: Report text goes only to an EU Data Zone model. Every AI verdict has an audit trail.
security.ai_suggests_nothing_leaves: AI suggests. Nothing leaves without the coordinator. Prototype, not a medical device.

built.a_real_hl7_order: A real HL7 order → IRIS → FHIR in ~1 s
built.ai_judges_the_whole: AI judges the whole case and cites the guideline page
built.89_461_report_sentences: 89,461 report sentences as vectors in IRIS
built.case_summary_as_a: Case summary as a versioned FHIR document
built.mcp_server_for_any: MCP server for any AI agent
built.the_prototype_simulates_orders: The prototype simulates orders, data from other hospitals and the insurer, and e-mail sending.

physicians.the_whole_history_on: The whole history on one timeline. A red flag when a critical scan is missing.
physicians.scans_reports_treatment_labs: Scans, reports, treatment, labs. Semantic search.
physicians.lights_up_only_areas: Lights up only areas with proven imaging. Missing ones in red.

impact.fewer_duplicates_shorter_waits: Fewer duplicates. Shorter waits. Less radiation for cancer patients.
impact.of_cases_would_start: of cases would start without a comparison

scale.it_connects_what_it: It connects what it has: HL7 v2, FHIR, a PACS feed.
scale.on_prem_or_eu: On-prem or EU cloud. Supported by a Czech IT integrator.
scale.image_exchange_under_ehds: Image exchange under EHDS comes only in 2031.

roadmap.for_us_this_is: For us, this is not just a weekend hackathon.
roadmap.real_orders_clinical_sign: Real orders, clinical sign-off of the AI.
roadmap.insurer_data_sub: An extra source of exams. KOMPACS works without it.
